subject: Initial discovery + demo — Pegasus Manufacturing
messages:
From: Priya Rao <prao@pegasus-mfg.com>
To: evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@pegasus-mfg.com, Sam Thompson <sam@pegasus-mfg.com>
Date: 2026-06-25T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Initial discovery / demo request

Hi Evelyn and Aditya,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier this week. We're interested in a short discovery call to evaluate Redwood for our inference needs. We're primarily focused on predictable latency for on-prem inference and secure private deployment (VPC + KMS).

Attendees from our side:
- Priya Rao (Product Manager, internal champion)
- Sam Thompson (Lead SW Engineer)
- Procurement (procurement@pegasus-mfg.com) — will likely join for any commercial discussion
- Security engineer (TBD) — may join if schedule allows

Attached is a short requirements dump (pegasus_requirements.xlsx) to give context. We'd like a 45–60 minute session with: brief intro (Redwood capabilities), technical Q&A (SE), and next steps for procurement.

We are in Pacific time. Here are windows that work for our team next week:
- Tue 6/30: 09:00–11:30 PT
- Wed 7/1: 13:00–16:00 PT
- Thu 7/2: 09:00–12:00 PT

Please let us know who from Redwood will attend (AE/SE) and if any of these slots work.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Rao
Product Manager, Pegasus Manufacturing
prao@pegasus-mfg.com

Attachment: pegasus_requirements.xlsx

From: evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Priya Rao <prao@pegasus-mfg.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Thompson <sam@pegasus-mfg.com>, procurement@pegasus-mfg.com
Date: 2026-06-25T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial discovery / demo request

Hi Priya — thanks for the details and the attachment. Happy to coordinate.

I'll plan to have Aditya (AE) and Dev Patel (SE) join for the technical discussion. Proposed agenda (45–60 min):
1) 10 min — intros & goals
2) 20–30 min — technical deep dive (deployment modes, private VPC, KMS, latency profiles)
3) 10–15 min — procurement & next steps (pricing / timelines)

We have the following Redwood-side availability next week (all PT):
- Tue 6/30: 09:30–10:30, 10:30–11:30
- Wed 7/1: 14:00–15:00
- Thu 7/2: 10:00–11:00

Would one of those work for you? I'll hold a provisional Google Calendar invite once you confirm a time and will include a short demo deck + discovery agenda.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Office: +1 (415) 555-0123

--
Evelyn Hart
Redwood Inference

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Priya Rao <prao@pegasus-mfg.com>, evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Sam Thompson <sam@pegasus-mfg.com>
Date: 2026-06-25T10:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial discovery / demo request

Hi Priya — Aditya here. Thanks for sending the requirements — helpful. Dev and I can cover the SE track and run through a short demo focused on on-prem and VPC flows.

Quick note on timing: Wed 7/1 14:00 PT works for us today but if you prefer Tue morning we can also make 09:30–10:30 PT (tight for Aditya but possible). If procurement needs to join, please let us know which slot they prefer.

I'll attach a short demo deck and a proposed discovery agenda to the invite so everyone has context.

Attachments: redwood-demo-deck.pdf, discovery-agenda.docx

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
Phone: (415) 555-0177

From: Priya Rao <prao@pegasus-mfg.com>
To: evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@pegasus-mfg.com, Sam Thompson <sam@pegasus-mfg.com>
Date: 2026-06-26T11:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial discovery / demo request

Thanks, Evelyn and Aditya. Apologies — procurement just scheduled a required internal review on Tue morning, so Tue 6/30 09:30 is no longer possible for us.

We'd prefer to move to Wed 7/1 at 14:00 PT (that slot works for Sam and most of the team). Can you confirm and send an invite? Also, Sam asked if we could carve out 15 minutes at the end for a quick discussion on data residency and audit logs — will that fit into the agenda?

Thanks,
Priya

From: evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Priya Rao <prao@pegasus-mfg.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Thompson <sam@pegasus-mfg.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, procurement@pegasus-mfg.com
Date: 2026-06-26T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial discovery / demo request

Hi Priya — confirmed Wed 2026-07-01 14:00–15:00 PT. I've sent a calendar invite here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123pegasus (provisional until you accept).

We'll extend the agenda by 15 minutes at the end for data residency & audit logs as requested. Final agenda attached (discovery-agenda.docx) and I'll also share the demo deck ahead of the call.

If procurement has any docs or PO cadence they want us to review beforehand, can procurement@pegasus-mfg.com drop those in the Google Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1PegasusDiscovery ?

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Evelyn
--
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwood.com

From: Sam Thompson <sam@pegasus-mfg.com>
To: evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <prao@pegasus-mfg.com>, procurement@pegasus-mfg.com, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-29T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial discovery / demo request

Confirmed for Wed 7/1 14:00 PT — calendar invite accepted. Dev, thanks for planning the residency + audit logs section; our security engineer may drop in for that segment.

One ask before the call: can you share a short note on expected throughput and latency for a typical on-prem deployment of a 7B model (approx. 8–10 qps, 256 token avg)? That will help us prepare specific load questions.

See you then — Sam
Sam Thompson
Lead Software Engineer, Pegasus Manufacturing
sam@pegasus-mfg.com
